No, that is not correct based on Swiss law. In Switzerland, you can change your basic health insurance provider **at any time** throughout the year. There is no legal requirement to cancel your current insurance by a specific deadline (such as December 31st) for the switch to take effect in the new year. You can usually switch your insurance provider with immediate effect once the new insurer confirms your coverage.

However, it is important to note that you **must not have any outstanding premiums or debts** with your current insurer for the switch to be processed without complications. Always confirm the exact terms and deadlines directly with the new insurance company you wish to join.
